WITH bucket_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5'
        END AS bucket,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4'
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5'
        END
)
SELECT 
    bucket_metrics.avg_ext_tax AS bucket1,
    bucket_metrics.avg_net_paid_inc_tax AS bucket2,
    bucket_metrics.avg_ext_tax AS bucket3,
    bucket_metrics.avg_net_paid_inc_tax AS bucket4,
    bucket_metrics.avg_ext_tax AS bucket5
FROM bucket_metrics
